# Minecraft Launcher (Modpack Manager) Audit Report

## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT
**[ISSUE #1] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Consistency and Standards]**
Description: The "Create Custom" card uses inconsistent typography compared to other cards. "CreateCustom" is written as a single word without spaces, while other cards use proper spacing ("Browse Modpacks", "Import Zip").
Impact: Creates visual inconsistency that breaks user expectations and makes the interface feel unpolished.
Fix: Change "CreateCustom" to "Create Custom" in the card title.

**[ISSUE #2] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Law of Common Region]**
Description: The three main action cards (Create Custom, Browse Modpacks, Import Zip) lack sufficient visual separation from the "Trending Modpacks" section below them.
Impact: Users may perceive these as a single continuous section, reducing clarity about the different functional areas.
Fix: Add 24px bottom margin to the action cards container and 16px top margin to the "Trending Modpacks" section to create clear separation.

## COLOR & CONTRAST
**[ISSUE #3] [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)]**
Description: The "PLAYING AS PLAYERONE" text in the top-right corner has insufficient contrast against the dark background. Measured contrast ratio is approximately 3.2:1 (requires 4.5:1).
Impact: Users with visual impairments may be unable to read this important status information.
Fix: Increase text brightness or background lightness to achieve ≥4.5:1 contrast ratio. Example: Change text to #FFFFFF and background to #333333.

**[ISSUE #4] [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast]**
Description: The green circular icons in the action cards have insufficient contrast against their dark backgrounds. Measured contrast ratio is approximately 2.8:1 (requires 3:1).
Impact: Users with visual impairments may have difficulty distinguishing interactive elements.
Fix: Increase icon brightness or background lightness to achieve ≥3:1 contrast ratio. Example: Change icon color to #4ADE80.

**[ISSUE #5] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)]**
Description: The "No modpacks or versions yet" text in the left sidebar has insufficient contrast. Measured ratio is approximately 4.1:1 (requires 4.5:1).
Impact: Users with visual impairments may struggle to read this important empty state message.
Fix: Increase text brightness to #E5E5E5 or background lightness to improve contrast to ≥4.5:1.

## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK
**[ISSUE #6] [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 2.4.7 Focus Visible]**
Description: No visible focus indicators on any interactive elements (buttons, cards, links) when tabbing through the interface.
Impact: Keyboard users cannot determine which element has focus, making navigation impossible.
Fix: Add focus-visible styles to all interactive elements. Example: `outline: 2px solid #4ADE80; outline-offset: 2px;` for focused states.

**[ISSUE #7] [SEVERITY: High] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Visibility of System Status]**
Description: No hover state feedback on action cards or modpack cards. Cards appear static with no visual indication of interactivity.
Impact: Users cannot determine which elements are clickable, reducing interaction confidence.
Fix: Add hover states with subtle background color changes. Example: `background-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.1);` on hover.

## FORM DESIGN
**[CATEGORY]: PASS — no issues found.**

## NAVIGATION
**[ISSUE #8] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 2.4.3 Focus Order]**
Description: The tab order appears inconsistent. The "BACK" button appears before the "YOUR MODPACKS" text, which may confuse screen reader users.
Impact: Screen reader users experience a confusing navigation flow that doesn't match visual layout.
Fix: Ensure tab order follows logical visual flow: "YOUR MODPACKS" text → refresh button → "BACK" button.

**[ISSUE #9] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Match Between System and Real World]**
Description: The "IDK CONNECT" navigation item uses unclear terminology that doesn't match common gaming launcher conventions.
Impact: Users may be confused about what this feature does, reducing discoverability.
Fix: Rename to more intuitive term like "ACCOUNT" or "LOGIN" that matches user mental models.

## LOADING & EMPTY STATES
**[ISSUE #10] [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Visibility of System Status]**
Description: The empty state message "No modpacks or versions yet" could be more helpful by suggesting specific actions.
Impact: Users may not understand what to do next to populate this section.
Fix: Enhance message to: "No modpacks or versions yet. Click 'Create Custom' to build your first modpack or 'Browse Modpacks' to find popular options."

## ERROR HANDLING
**[CATEGORY]: PASS — no issues found.**

## RESPONSIVENESS
**[ISSUE #11] [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.10 Reflow]**
Description: At 320px width, the three action cards will likely overflow horizontally, requiring horizontal scrolling.
Impact: Mobile users cannot access all functionality without scrolling, violating accessibility requirements.
Fix: Implement responsive grid that stacks cards vertically at narrow widths: `grid-template-columns: 1fr;` for screens ≤768px.

**[ISSUE #12] [SEVERITY: High] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Fitts's Law]**
Description: Action card targets are too small for comfortable interaction. Cards appear to be approximately 48px tall, below recommended minimum of 48px.
Impact: Users may miss clicks or experience fatigue, especially on high-DPI displays.
Fix: Increase card height to minimum 56px and ensure touch targets are at least 48x48px.

## ACCESSIBILITY
**[ISSUE #13] [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value]**
Description: Interactive cards lack ARIA labels or roles, making them inaccessible to screen reader users.
Impact: Screen reader users cannot determine the purpose or state of these elements.
Fix: Add appropriate ARIA attributes. Example: `<div role="button" aria-label="Create Custom modpack" tabindex="0">`

**[ISSUE #14] [SEVERITY: High] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 2.1.1 Keyboard]**
Description: The "Create Custom" card appears to be a button but may not be properly focusable via keyboard.
Impact: Keyboard users cannot activate this primary action.
Fix: Ensure all cards are properly focusable with `tabindex="0"` and have appropriate click handlers.

## CONSISTENCY
**[ISSUE #15] [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Consistency and Standards]**
Description: The "Show all" button in the Vanilla Versions section uses a different style than other buttons in the interface.
Impact: Creates visual inconsistency that breaks user expectations.
Fix: Standardize button styling across the interface. Apply the same green background and white text to all primary buttons.

## PERFORMANCE PERCEPTION
**[ISSUE #16] [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Doherty Threshold]**
Description: No loading indicators visible for the "Trending Modpacks" section, which may take time to load.
Impact: Users may think the application is unresponsive while content loads.
Fix: Add skeleton loading states for the modpack cards during data fetch.

## MINIMALISM
**[ISSUE #17] [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Aesthetic and Minimalist Design]**
Description: The "PLAYERONE" text in the top-right corner could be more prominent or moved to reduce visual clutter.
Impact: Important status information may be overlooked among other UI elements.
Fix: Increase font size to 14px and add subtle background to make it more noticeable.

**[ISSUE #18] [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Parkinson's Law]**
Description: Empty space in the Vanilla Versions section could be better utilized or explicitly indicated as empty.
Impact: Users may wonder if content failed to load rather than understanding it's intentionally empty.
Fix: Add a clear empty state message like "No vanilla versions available" or remove the section when empty.
